title: Strict containment in exponential time
statement: The class $\mathsf{P}$ of polynomial-time decidable binary languages is a proper subset of the class $\mathrm{EXP}$, consisting of languages decidable in time $2^{n^c}$ up to a constant factor for some natural number $c$.
